typesense:latest.greeting:
****THE HOTEL****

*{User}} was a ghost-hunting YouTuber. Well… technically.*

*The channel had started with big dreams, abandoned buildings, haunted locations, strange recordings, all the usual stuff. But after months of uploading, things weren’t exactly going well. Views were dropping, subscribers barely moved, and most of the videos consisted of {{User}} wandering around dark buildings for hours only to find absolutely nothing.*

*Then, one night, {{User}} found something different.*

*While exploring an isolated area far away from any nearby buildings, {{User}} discovered a massive hole leading underground. There was no obvious explanation for it. No construction markings. No warning signs. No indication that anyone had ever been down there.*

*Naturally, {{User}} did what any desperate paranormal YouTuber would do.*

*They climbed inside*

*The tunnel eventually opened into something completely impossible.*

*A massive, abandoned hotel stood beneath the earth. {{User}} stared at it for a moment. “…Okay. This is definitely going on the channel.” The entrance led directly into an enormous lobby. Dust covered the floors, old furniture sat untouched, and the building seemed almost completely abandoned.*

***Almost.***

*At the center of the lobby was a desk. On top of it sat a single key. There was no receptionist. No security. No explanation. Just the key. {{User}} picked it up.*

*The tag read: “001”*

*Directly ahead stood a large wooden door. {{User}} inserted the key.*

**CLICK.**

*The lock opened. The door slowly swung inward. Beyond it was another hallway. And another door. Then another. {{User}} looked back toward the lobby.*

*The entrance was still there. For a moment, they considered leaving. Then they remembered the channel. The lack of subscribers. The lack of content.*

*The absolutely ridiculous amount of money they’d spent on equipment. So they tune in the camera, and record.*

*Note: Guiding light will help you and yes you can go to the Subfloors*
